ADVISORY: SUSPENSION OF CLASSES

In view of Tropical Storm Signal No. 1 raised over Cebu by PAGASA, Mayor's Office announces that classes at ALL LEVELS, public and private, in Lapu-Lapu City are SUSPENDED today, Friday, October 3, 2026.

Parents are advised to keep children at home. Stay safe, Oponganons!

MAAYONG BUNTAG, OPONGANONS! Malipayong pag-abiabi sa atong mga bisita sa Kadaugan sa Mactan Festival exhibit sa City Hall lobby. Bukas kini matag adlaw gikan alas 8 sa buntag. Ayaw kalimti pagdala sa inyong pamilya! #LapuLapuCity

WATER INTERRUPTION ADVISORY

SERVICE ADVISORY: Low pressure to no water is expected on Tuesday, October 7, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM in Lapu-Lapu City areas served by the Mactan transmission line: portions of Brgy. Pajo, Brgy. Gun-ob, Brgy. Poblacion and Brgy. Pusok, due to the replacement of a 600mm valve along M.L. Quezon National Highway. Water supply will be gradually restored after the activity. Customers are advised to store enough water. For concerns, call our hotline 256-0423 or message this page.

PAHINUMDOM: Mahimo na ninyong bayran ang inyong water bill pinaagi sa GCash, Maya ug sa among mga accredited payment centers. Ayaw na paglinya! Para sa lista sa payment partners, bisitaha ang among website.

UPDATE: Ang suspension ng klase ay EXTENDED hanggang bukas, Sabado, Oktubre 4, para sa lahat ng Saturday classes (ALS at senior high) sa public at private schools. Work in government offices resumes on Monday. Ingat po tayong lahat.

ABISO SA MGA MAGTUTUDLO UG ESTUDYANTE: Ang face-to-face classes sa Lapu-Lapu City National High School (main campus) suspendido karong adlawa human sa pagbaha sa campus. Modular learning ang ipatuman. Ang ubang eskwelahan sa siyudad padayon ang klase.

text: DIVISION ADVISORY: In view of PAGASA's Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal No. 1, in-person classes in all public schools in the Lapu-Lapu City Division are suspended on Friday, October 3, 2026. Learning continues through modules and online platforms. School heads shall monitor the safety of learners and personnel and report any damage to the Division Office. Private schools may decide on their own suspension. #DepEdLapuLapu

CONGRATULATIONS to the Lapu-Lapu City Central School dance troupe for winning first place at the Regional Schools Press and Arts Festival! The Division is proud of our learners, coaches and parents. #DepEdLapuLapu

TROPICAL CYCLONE BULLETIN NR. 6
Tropical Storm "Ompong" (synthetic name)
Issued at 11:00 PM, 02 October 2026

Location of center (10:00 PM): The center of Tropical Storm OMPONG was estimated based on all available data at 210 km East of Surigao City, Surigao del Norte.
Intensity: Maximum sustained winds of 75 km/h near the center, gustiness of up to 90 km/h, and central pressure of 994 hPa.
Present movement: West northwestward at 20 km/h.

TROPICAL CYCLONE WIND SIGNALS IN EFFECT
Wind Signal No. 2 (Gale-force winds, 39-61 km/h, minor to moderate threat to life and property): Surigao del Norte, Dinagat Islands, Southern Leyte, the southern portion of Leyte, Bohol.
Wind Signal No. 1 (Strong winds, minimal to minor threat): Cebu including Mactan Island (Lapu-Lapu City, Cordova), Camotes Islands, Negros Oriental, Siquijor, Eastern Samar, Samar, Biliran, the rest of Leyte, Misamis Oriental, Camiguin.

HAZARDS AFFECTING LAND AREAS
Heavy rainfall: Within the next 24 hours, 50-100 mm of rain is expected over Cebu, Bohol, Southern Leyte, Dinagat Islands and Surigao del Norte; 100-200 mm over Siargao Island.
Severe winds: Strong to gale-force winds may be experienced within any of the areas under Wind Signals.

HAZARDS AFFECTING COASTAL WATERS
A Gale Warning is in effect over the seaboards of Visayas. Sea travel is risky for small seacraft, including motor bankas.

TRACK AND INTENSITY OUTLOOK
OMPONG is forecast to cross the Visayas tomorrow, 03 October, passing near Bohol and Cebu in the afternoon, and emerge over the Sulu Sea by Saturday morning. It is expected to remain a tropical storm throughout.

The next bulletin will be issued at 5:00 AM today.

text: Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 for Central Visayas. ORANGE warning over Metro Cebu. Take precautionary measures. #PAGASA

WEATHER FORECAST for Central Visayas, 29 September 2026: Partly cloudy to cloudy skies with isolated rainshowers or thunderstorms due to localized thunderstorms. Light to moderate winds from the east with slight to moderate seas (0.6 to 1.5 m). Temperature range in Cebu City: 25-32 C.

GALE WARNING No. 4 issued at 5:00 PM, 02 October 2026. Strong to gale-force winds associated with Tropical Storm OMPONG will affect the seaboards of Cebu, Bohol, Leyte and Southern Leyte. Sea conditions will be rough to very rough (2.8 to 4.5 m). Fishing boats and other small seacraft are advised not to venture out to sea, while larger sea vessels are alerted against big waves.
